name: selection
description: File-level selection across a history of real commits: import, conftest and declared-read closure over the base and head trees, global inputs, deleted files.

actions.init: create a fixture repository and commit it
actions.edit: rewrite one file's body, commit, then select between the two commits
actions.link: add an import to one file, commit, then select
actions.unlink: remove an import from one file, commit, then select
actions.remove: delete a module or test file, commit, then select
actions.restore: add a deleted file back without imports, commit, then select
actions.touchGlobal: edit requirements.txt, a default global input, commit, then select
actions.inspect: read the last selection without committing

limits: One repository: three modules, a conftest, two tests and one declared data file; at most 6 commits per sampled history.

Covers import, ancestor-conftest and declared-read edges, file deletion and the default global inputs. First-party pins, name-scoped modules, deferred strings, Django URLconf policy and plugin-registering test modules are outside the model.
Each step is a real Git commit selected by affected() through one GraphCache per history; the driver's mapping of paths to file names is trusted.
